items.title: Tens of thousands line the streets as Norway bids farewell to King Harald V

sentences.en: Europe’s royals and global political figures attend ceremony that brings 13 days of national mourning to a close Norway has observed a minute’s silence as it takes leave of King Harald V in a series of ceremonies, bringing to a close 13 days of ​national mourning that followed the popular monarch’s death last month at the age of 89.

sentences.en: Tens of thousands of people lined the streets of Oslo and foreign heads of state and government converged on the Norwegian capital for the funeral of the late king, a light-touch and unassuming reformer who ruled for more than three decades.
sentences.zh: 成千上万的人在奥斯陆的街道上排队，外国国家元首和政府首脑聚集在挪威首都参加已故国王的葬礼，这位轻松而谦逊的改革者统治了三十多年。

sentences.en: The night before, the far-right populist, anti-immigrant, pro-Kremlin party Alternative für Deustchland (AfD) had landslide 44% win in Saxony-Anhalt’s state elections, sending shock waves to Berlin, across Germany and way beyond.
sentences.zh: 前一天晚上，极右翼民粹主义者、反移民、亲克里姆林宫的Alternative für Deustchland （ AfD ）在萨克森-安哈尔特州选举中以44 ％的压倒性优势获胜，给柏林、整个德国以及更远的地方带来了冲击波。

sentences.en: Regardless of how people in the capital voted, it felt like a bit of an affront to probe.

sentences.en: Given the radical plans of the victors, a party classified by domestic intelligence as “rightwing extremist” , that is what I wanted to know.

sentences.en: But from the 21-year-old Guinean-German paramedic I met at the central bus station, collecting donations for a local hospice, to the elderly couple returning to their apartment after a stroll down the Elbe river, almost everyone I met opened up to me warmly.
sentences.zh: 但是，从我在中央公共汽车站遇到的21岁的几内亚-德国护理人员，为当地的临终关怀收集捐款，到在易北河漫步后返回公寓的老年夫妇，我遇到的几乎所有人都热情地向我敞开心扉。

items.title: How we rebuilt Cloudflare Workers’ module registry for Node.js compatibility

sentences.en: How we rebuilt Cloudflare Workers’ module registry for Node.js compatibility.
sentences.zh: 我们如何重建Cloudflare Workers的模块注册表以实现Node.js兼容性。

sentences.en: We’ve rewritten the module registry in workerd , the core open-source component of the Workers runtime, to be faster, more standards-compliant, and more closely aligned with Node.js' module registry.
sentences.zh: 我们在workerd （ Workers运行时的核心开源组件）中重写了模块注册表，使其更快、更符合标准，并与Node.js的模块注册表更紧密地对齐。

sentences.en: Over the past few years, we’ve been adding support for more and more Node.js runtime APIs.
sentences.zh: 在过去的几年中，我们一直在添加对越来越多的Node.js运行时API的支持。

sentences.en: The Workers runtime now supports every stable API from Node.js that you might want to use in a serverless context, and these APIs are now enabled by default , letting you deploy even larger Node.js apps to Cloudflare (now up to 64 MiB on all plans — we’ve removed the limit on compressed bundle size).
sentences.zh: Workers运行时现在支持Node.js中您可能希望在无服务器上下文中使用的每个稳定API ，并且这些API现在已默认启用，允许您将更大的Node.js应用程序部署到Cloudflare （现在所有计划最高可达64 MiB —我们已取消对压缩捆绑包大小的限制）。

sentences.en: But API compatibility alone is not enough: Node.js applications also depend on how the runtime resolves, loads, and caches modules .
sentences.zh: 但仅有API兼容性是不够的： Node.js应用程序还取决于运行时如何解析、加载和缓存模块。

sentences.en: ESM, CommonJS, and WebAssembly are each types of modules that you can import in your Worker’s code.
sentences.zh: ESM、CommonJS和WebAssembly是可以在Worker代码中导入的每种类型的模块。

sentences.en: The system within the runtime that handles all of this is called the module registry.
sentences.zh: 运行时中处理所有这些的系统称为模块注册表。

sentences.en: You can start using it today by enabling the new_module_registry compatibility flag in your Worker.
sentences.zh: 您可以立即通过在Worker中启用new_module_registry兼容性标志开始使用它。

sentences.en: When you enable the new_module_registry compatibility flag: import.meta.url , import.meta.main , and import.meta.resolve() all work.
sentences.zh: 启用new_module_registry兼容性标志时： import.meta.url、import.meta.main和import.meta.resolve ()均有效。

sentences.en: Module specifiers are parsed and resolved as real URLs, including query strings and fragments.
sentences.zh: 模块说明符被解析和解析为真实URL ，包括查询字符串和片段。

sentences.en: node: built-ins resolve to the same module instance no matter how you reach them.
sentences.zh: node:内置解析到相同的模块实例，无论您如何访问它们。

sentences.en: Import attributes ( with { type: 'json' } ) are correctly validated.
sentences.zh: 导入属性（具有{type: 'json'} ）已正确验证。

items.title: Your work might not need the smartest model

sentences.en: Your work might not need the smartest model.
sentences.zh: 您的工作可能不需要最聪明的模型。

sentences.en: Your work might not need the smartest model.
sentences.zh: 您的工作可能不需要最聪明的模型。

sentences.en: With all the enthusiasm for GPT-6 Astra, it’s easy to make it your default and expect the best result every time.
sentences.zh: 凭借对GPT-6 Astra的所有热情，您可以轻松地将其设为默认值，并期望每次都能获得最佳效果。

sentences.en: That expectation is worth testing, because the improvement on your work needs to justify the cost.
sentences.zh: 这种期望值得检验，因为对工作的改进需要证明成本的合理性。

sentences.en: Even when the organization pays for usage, the choices developers make throughout the day still add up.
sentences.zh: 即使组织为使用付费，开发人员全天做出的选择仍然是累积的。

sentences.en: For a team choosing where to spend its agent budget, the useful question is what’s the minimal viable model for our work?
sentences.zh: 对于一个选择将座席预算花费在哪里的团队来说，一个有用的问题是，我们工作的最小可行模型是什么？

sentences.en: Finding the least expensive model that meets your requirements starts with choosing candidates, which a leaderboard can help you do.
sentences.zh: 找到满足您要求的最便宜的模型，首先要选择候选人，排行榜可以帮助您做到这一点。

sentences.en: Evaluating those candidates on your own tasks tells you which supports your team’s workflow best.
sentences.zh: 在您自己的任务上评估这些求职者可以告诉您哪个最适合您的团队工作流程。

sentences.en: What the upgrade buys you In an earlier model comparison , a newer model followed explicit upgrade instructions more reliably, while the older model produced more idiomatic architecture in the scenarios we measured.
sentences.zh: 在早期的模型比较中，较新的模型更可靠地遵循明确的升级说明，而较旧的模型在我们测量的场景中产生了更惯用的架构。

sentences.en: Whether the upgrade helped depended on the type of work we gave it.
sentences.zh: 升级是否有帮助取决于我们提供的工作类型。

sentences.en: Public benchmarks measure their own set of tasks in a particular environment, so your repositories and agent setup can produce different results .
sentences.zh: 公共基准在特定环境中衡量自己的任务集，因此您的存储库和代理设置可以产生不同的结果。

sentences.en: To see what that tradeoff looked like for Astra, we compared it with Claude Sonnet 4.6, a commonly used model, across three code upgrade scenarios.
sentences.zh: 为了了解Astra的权衡，我们在三个代码升级场景中将其与常用模型Claude Sonnet 4.6进行了比较。

sentences.en: Three men are on trial over the death of brothers Jake and Callum Robinson and their friend, US citizen Jack Carter Rhoad, in Ensenada The father of two Australian surfers killed in Mexico two years ago testified in court on Tuesday that his life had been turned into hell, as the high-profile trial continued into its second day.
sentences.zh: 三名男子因杰克和卡勒姆·罗宾逊兄弟以及他们的朋友、美国公民杰克·卡特·罗德（ Jack Carter Rhoad ）在恩塞纳达（ Ensenada ）的死亡而受审。两年前在墨西哥遇害的两名澳大利亚冲浪者的父亲周二在法庭上作证说，随着这场备受瞩目的审判进入第二天，他的生活已经变成了地狱。

items.title: Babies born to anaemic mothers have smaller brains, study finds

sentences.en: Babies born to anaemic mothers have smaller brains, study finds.

sentences.en: Key regions of the brain linked to movement, learning and emotions were affected and may lead to cognitive problems Babies born to mothers with anaemia have smaller brains, particularly in key regions linked to movement, learning and the regulation of emotion, according to a study.
sentences.zh: 根据一项研究，与运动、学习和情绪相关的大脑关键区域受到影响，并可能导致认知问题。贫血母亲所生的婴儿大脑较小，特别是在与运动、学习和情绪调节相关的关键区域。

sentences.en: Researchers said the differences, first detected at the age of one, could lead to cognitive problems when children started school.
sentences.zh: 研究人员表示，这种差异最初是在1岁时发现的，当孩子们开始上学时，可能会导致认知问题。

sentences.en: Trump responds after Canada imposes $20bn in retaliatory tariffs and Canadian PM vows to diversify trade abroad The US is banning dairy products, most alcoholic beverages and motorcycles from Canada , the White House said on Tuesday, as the trade war between the two neighbors and longtime allies escalates.

items.title: Kubernetes v1.37: Advancing Workload-Aware Scheduling

sentences.en: Kubernetes v1.37: Advancing Workload-Aware Scheduling.
sentences.zh: Kubernetes v 1.37 ：推进工作负载感知调度。

sentences.en: AI/ML and complex batch workloads continue to push the boundaries of Kubernetes scheduling.
sentences.zh: AI/ML和复杂的批处理工作负载继续推动Kubernetes调度的边界。

sentences.en: Following the foundational workload-centric enhancements introduced in previous releases, Kubernetes v1.37 delivers the next major milestone in the Workload-Aware Scheduling (WAS) journey.
sentences.zh: 继先前版本中引入的以工作负载为中心的基础增强功能之后， Kubernetes v 1.37提供了工作负载感知调度（ WAS ）旅程中的下一个重要里程碑。

sentences.en: In this release, the core Workload and PodGroup APIs—enabling gang scheduling—along with Workload-Aware Preemption (WAP) and shared DRA ResourceClaims for PodGroups, all graduate to Beta, solidifying their role in the Kubernetes ecosystem.
sentences.zh: 在此版本中，核心Workload和PodGroup API （启用帮派调度） ，以及Workload-Aware Preemption (WAP)和共享DRA ResourceClaims for PodGroups ，都毕业于Beta版，巩固了他们在Kubernetes生态系统中的角色。

sentences.en: To address the hierarchical scheduling requirements of modern high-performance distributed workloads, v1.37 introduces the new CompositePodGroup API.
sentences.zh: 为了满足现代高性能分布式工作负载的分层调度要求， v 1.37引入了新的CompositePodGroup API。

sentences.en: This new API allows expressing multi-level topology constraints, gang scheduling, and preemption policies for complex, heterogeneous groups of Pods.
sentences.zh: 这个新的API允许为复杂的异构Pod组表达多级拓扑约束、帮派调度和抢占策略。

sentences.en: Crucially, this architectural expansion unlocks native scheduling support for advanced workload structures commonly managed by higher-order extension APIs such as JobSet and LeaderWorkerSet (LWS).
sentences.zh: 至关重要的是，此架构扩展为高级扩展API （如JobSet和LeaderWorkerSet （ LWS ） ）通常管理的高级工作负载结构解锁了本机调度支持。

sentences.en: Alongside these API additions, v1.37 focuses on streamlining adoption by introducing a new set of controller integration APIs and the workloadbuilder Go library.
sentences.zh: 除了这些API添加之外， v 1.37还通过引入一组新的控制器集成API和工作负载构建器Go库来简化采用。

sentences.en: These provide standardized building blocks that significantly simplify how out-of-tree controllers can integrate with WAS capabilities.
sentences.zh: 这些模块提供了标准化的构建模块，大大简化了树外控制器与WAS功能的集成方式。

sentences.en: Utilizing these new tools, the native Job controller integration has been upgraded to fully consume the expanded WAS APIs—enabling advanced scheduling policies, flexible disruption modes, and topology-aware scheduling for standard batch workloads.
sentences.zh: 利用这些新工具，本机作业控制器集成已升级为完全使用扩展的WAS API ，为标准批处理工作负载启用高级调度策略、灵活的中断模式和拓扑感知调度。

sentences.en: Gang scheduling and Workload / PodGroup APIs Kubernetes v1.37 delivers a major milestone: Workload / PodGroup APIs and gang scheduling are officially graduating to Beta.
This graduation signals that native, "all-or-nothing" scheduling for workloads is solidifying for wider adoption.
